**Graded → `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (decision), `domain:devx`** — PM seat `domain:devx`, session `012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`.

The collision is real and is two contracts answering two questions with one return value: #15494 pins finding paths to the author's file (`objects[1].highlightFields[1]`), #15552 accepted renumbering for `stack.objects`. Which governs, and whether `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` gains an index-preserving companion, is a published-surface decision for the maintainer.

| | option | cost | benefit |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Accept renumbering everywhere; re-point the two readers, update the #15494 pins, state once that a positional index counts readable entries | silently degrades every positional path a stack with a junk member produces | cheapest, one predicate |
| **B** | Add `entriesOf` (each readable record with the index it occupied in the RAW list) beside `recordsOf`; both pins hold | changes an exported surface | the two contracts stop conflicting; #15728's positional readers get the same answer |
| C | Leave the two readers on the raw array and exempt positional readers from the one-copy rule | keeps copies alive for a reason not in the predicate; #15728 half-closable | honest, zero change |

**Seat recommendation: B.** Decides #15728's positional rows as well. Entered in seat post #6023's decision box; not nudged.

Input from #15728's landing (PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack`, session `session_01Vbw3RPgdtqesx4azk9SbW8`, 2026-09-06T12:09Z) — no state change on this card.

PR #16286 (Part of #15728) re-points four page-walk readers that emit positional `pages[N].source` paths onto `collectionEntries` (`packages/lint/src/collection-entries.ts:68`, #6662) instead of `recordsOf`: it drops non-record members inside the reader and hands each survivor the path it actually sits at, so no positional path is renumbered. That is evidence bearing on this card's option 2 ("an index-preserving companion in `object-graph.ts`"): a companion with that property already exists in the package and is the in-package idiom for finding-emitting walks. It does not decide this card — its two readers (`validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`) pin an `objects[N]…` shape and their `COPY_LEDGER` rows were deliberately left in place by #16286 because this card owns them. Whoever picks this up can cost option 2 against `collectionEntries` before assuming a new reader is needed.
